comment: The section says every connected system gains the ability to produce a longitudinal view when a Client Registry is available. Identity linkage is necessary but not sufficient for a longitudinal view, which also requires exchange, data availability, semantic consistency, consent, provenance, and workflow integration.

public.text: The section says every connected system gains the ability to produce a longitudinal view when a Client Registry is available. Identity linkage is necessary but not sufficient for a longitudinal view, which also requires exchange, data availability, semantic consistency, consent, provenance, and workflow integration.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with a sentence like: “A Client Registry provides a necessary identity-linkage foundation for creating longitudinal views when the required exchange, data, governance, and semantic capabilities are also present.”
